summary: Iteration 5 retest confirms the count>=5 regression from iteration 4 is FIXED. New pytest suite test_retest_iter5.py (5 tests, all passing in 262s with mandatory 60s TPM spacing) covers: count=3 smart-agriculture (3s, 3/3 keyword hits), count=5 renewable-energy (4.4s, 5/5 hits, all distinct titles like 'Smart Solar Panel Optimizer', 'Wind-Turbine Fault Detector', 'AI-Powered Home Energy Advisor', 'Hybrid Renewable Microgrid Simulator', 'AI-Enhanced Solar IoT Dashboard'), count=10 music-production (8s, 10/10 hits, all distinct), refine 200 OK, viva returns exactly 8 questions. Frontend E2E: login via header 'Log in' link, click idea-count-5-button, fill data-testid=interests-input with 'renewable energy', submit generate-ideas-button - 5 project-card elements rendered plus 'AI ready' + '5 ideas ready' success toast. No React '<option> complex children' hydration warnings in console during the entire flow. Groq single-lean-call + parse_ideas truncation salvage fix is working end-to-end within the 60s gateway. TPM constraint respected throughout (never observed a 503 during retest).

minor.issue: If AI still returns fewer ideas than requested, ideas[:count] silently returns fewer items instead of 503. Low priority - not observed in this retest but still a latent risk on tier-limited retries.

critical_code_review_comments: generate() still slices ideas[:inp.count] without asserting equality; masks partial failures if Groq under-delivers. Consider raising 503 with a clear detail when len(ideas) < inp.count after top-up.
JWT_SECRET falls back to secrets.token_hex per process if env missing; all sessions invalidate on backend restart. Recommend requiring JWT_SECRET at startup.
current_user() uses __import__('bson').ObjectId(...) inline; will 500 (not 401) if the token 'sub' is not a valid ObjectId. Wrap in try/except and raise 401.
seed_data_creation: None - live AI generations against the admin account (adds ~18 projects to history)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Groq single-lean-call fix verified end-to-end for count=3/5/10 plus refine and viva=8. Free-tier TPM is 8000/min so ALWAYS space generate calls 60s apart (never parallel); back-to-back calls will 503 as tier limit, not bug. Existing test_retest_iter5.py serial runs in ~4:22 with 60s waits and is the regression suite going forward. Interests input has data-testid='interests-input'. No React option warnings remain.
rca of the issue: Regression from iteration 4 (count>=5 -> 503) was caused by Groq gpt-oss-120b reasoning model truncating JSON output when no max_completion_tokens was passed. Fix (verified this iteration): (a) single AI call with max_completion_tokens=7000 and reasoning_effort=low, (b) prompt instructs concise strings <=22 words and lists <=5 items so 10 full ideas fit, (c) parse_ideas salvages truncated JSON arrays by trimming to the last complete object. Result: count=5 returns 5 complete distinct ideas in ~4s, count=10 in ~8s, both well under the 60s gateway.
